==Facilities==
[[Martin Thwait]] runs the general store [[Martin Thwait's Lost and Found]], which sells [[throwing knives]], [[claws]], [[lockpick]]s, and other items. Access to the shop requires 50 Thieving and 50 Agility or 99 Thieving. It is notable for buying items at their [[High Level Alchemy]] price rather than their [[Low Level Alchemy]] price. Martin also sells the [[Thieving cape]] and [[Thieving hood|hood]] to players with 99 Thieving.

[[Emerald Benedict]] runs the [[bank]]. He stands one tile away from an everlasting [[fire]], making him one of the three closest banks to a [[Cooking]] location other than the range in the [[Myths' Guild]] and the [[sulphur vent]] in [[Mor Ul Rek]].

[[Grace]] runs [[Grace's Graceful Clothing]]  which sells the [[Graceful outfit]] and [[Amylase pack]] in exchange for [[Mark of grace|Marks of grace]].
